audit.description: Changed production code imports and uses the real urllib3 API in hxl/input.py and hxl/scripts.py, including urllib3.PoolManager and urllib3.util.retry.Retry for HTTP requests. The diff removes direct requests imports and requests.get/head/post call sites from changed production files, and setup.py removes the requests dependency while retaining urllib3. Dynamic evidence shows urllib3 loaded from site-packages with no source-library imports from production repo and no local target provider detected.
evidence: hxl/input.py: import urllib3 and from urllib3.util.retry import Retry added; _http_pool returns urllib3.PoolManager(**kwargs) and _request calls .request(...)
hxl/scripts.py: requests removed from import list; urllib3, urllib.error, ssl, and Retry added; remote JSON load uses urllib3.PoolManager(...).request('GET', ...)
setup.py: 'requests' removed from install_requires while 'urllib3' remains
reasons: hxl/input.py and hxl/scripts.py meaningfully use urllib3 request machinery
requests import and direct requests call sites were removed from changed production code
dynamic audit reports zero requests imports from production repo
target origin is site-packages urllib3 and target_local_spec_count is 0

+class _HTTPResponseAdapter:

+            raise urllib.error.HTTPError(url, self.status_code, 'HTTP {}'.format(self.status_code), self.headers, None)

+    def close(self):

+def _request(method, url, input_options, headers=None, fields=None, body=None, redirect=True):
+    try:

+            timeout=input_options.timeout,
+            redirect=redirect,

+        raise urllib.error.URLError(e)
